description: This file defines the LocationService class in a Human Resource Management project. It provides methods for managing location entities, including fetching, searching, counting, saving, deleting, and fetching accessible locations. It also interacts with the DAO layer and utilizes traits for normalization, user role management, and employee services.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Service class handling business logic related to Location entities in the HRM system, including retrieval, search, count, and modification operations, with role-based access considerations.

methods.name: getLocationDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LocationDao instance used for data access.

methods.name: setLocationDao
methods.description: Sets the LocationDao instance, allowing for dependency injection or mocking.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Fetches a Location entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations based on specified filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of locations matching the search filter.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Gets the total number of employees assigned to a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves location IDs for a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of locations accessible to the specified employee, merging role-based and direct associations.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Persists a Location entity into the database.

methods.name: deleteLocations
methods.description: Flags multiple locations as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getLocationsArray
methods.description: Fetches all locations and normalizes them into an array of models.
